mds components

mds:date-picker

A date field you can type into, with a Jalali calendar in a popover — an open version of a Flux Pro component.

A text field, a button, and mds:calendar inside mds:popover — nothing here re-implements a calendar. Click the chevron to pick a day, or type one: the field reads «۱۴۰۵/۰۵/۲۹» as readily as 1405/05/29 or 14050529. Whatever you do, the hidden input holds 2026-08-20.

Delivery day
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/05/29 
<mds:date-picker wire:model="deliverAt" label="Delivery day" value="2026-08-20" />
The field and the model speak different languages on purpose. The reader gets a Jalali date in the digits they read; Carbon, your database and date_format:Y-m-d get an ordinary ISO Gregorian string.

Typing a date

Three rules, the same in PHP and in the browser. A dashed Y-m-d from 1700 onwards is the machine form and always Gregorian. Every other separator — and a bare YYYYMMDD — is read in the field's own calendar, and so is a dashed date below 1700, so 1405-05-29 is Mordad rather than a date in 1405 AD. Anything else is not a date at all: it is refused, and the field puts back what it had.

Try 1372/03/15, 13720315 or nonsense
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD No date selected
Seeded from a written date
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/05/29 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
    <mds:date-picker label="Try 1372/03/15, 13720315 or nonsense" />
    <mds:date-picker label="Seeded from a written date" value="1405/05/29" />
</div>
Nothing unreadable becomes a value. A month past twelve, the 30th of a common Esfand, a two-digit year — all refused, and the last good date stays. Press Enter or leave the field to commit; Escape puts it back.

How it is written back

format picks the shape the field writes. numeric is the typeable one; long spells the month out, and is still typeable — type numerals and it re-renders long.

numeric
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/05/29
long
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 29 Mordad 1405 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
    <mds:date-picker label="numeric" value="2026-08-20" />
    <mds:date-picker format="long" label="long" value="2026-08-20" />
</div>

Ranges

A range writes both ends into one field. The panel stays open until the span is closed, and the two ends bind to dotted paths under your property — wire:model="trip" fills trip.start and trip.end, exactly as mds:calendar does. Typing accepts «تا», "to", a dash or a comma between the two dates.

Stay
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD — two dates separated by "to" Selected: 1405/05/29 – 1405/06/04 
<mds:date-picker mode="range" wire:model="trip" label="Stay" :months="2" fixed-weeks
    :value="['2026-08-20', '2026-08-26']" />

Bounds and days off

Everything the grid understands is one prop away: min and max close the ends, unavailable takes out single days, with-today adds the shortcut, week-numbers the extra column. They are handed straight to mds:calendar.

Delivery day
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/06/02 
<mds:date-picker label="Delivery day" value="2026-08-24"
    min="2026-08-16" max="2026-09-12" :unavailable="['2026-08-28', '2026-09-04']"
    week-numbers with-today clearable />
Bounds may be written the way the field is: min="۱۴۰۵/۰۵/۲۵" means the same thing as min="2026-08-16".

Long ago

A date of birth is the case a calendar alone handles badly — nobody pages back three hundred months. Type it, or use selectable-header to jump by month and year.

Date of birth
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 15 Khordad 1372 
<mds:date-picker label="Date of birth" selectable-header format="long" value="1993-06-05" />

Where the panel opens

position and align go to the popover, so they are logical: start and end resolve against the field's own direction, and the panel flips when the viewport runs out of room.

bottom / start (default)
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD No date selected
top / end
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD No date selected 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
    <mds:date-picker label="bottom / start (default)" />
    <mds:date-picker position="top" align="end" label="top / end" />
</div>

The Gregorian field

Same component, other calendar. calendar="gregorian" reads and writes Gregorian dates in the grid and in the field — the machine value was Gregorian all along, so nothing else changes.

Invoiced at
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 2026/08/20
Invoiced at, spelled out
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 20 August 2026 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
    <mds:date-picker calendar="gregorian" label="Invoiced at" value="2026-08-20" />
    <mds:date-picker calendar="gregorian" format="long" label="Invoiced at, spelled out" value="2026-08-20" />
</div>

States

An explicit error wins; without one the message comes from the error bag for name. disabled takes the whole field out of reach, readonly keeps the calendar but stops the typing.

Delivery day
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD No date selected
Pick a delivery day.
Pick only
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/05/29
Not this time
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/05/29 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
    <mds:date-picker name="deliver_at" label="Delivery day" error="Pick a delivery day." />
    <mds:date-picker label="Pick only" readonly value="2026-08-20" />
    <mds:date-picker label="Not this time" disabled value="2026-08-20" />
</div>

Keyboard and screen readers

The WAI-ARIA date-picker-dialog pattern. The field is an ordinary labelled input described by a format hint; the button carries aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; the panel is a named role="dialog" around the calendar's role="grid". ↓ in the field opens the panel and lands on the day the grid would tab to, then the calendar's own arrows take over; Esc closes and hands focus back to the button; Enter commits what you typed. A live region announces the selection.

Delivery day
Date format: YYYY/MM/DD Selected: 1405/06/02 
<mds:date-picker label="Delivery day" value="2026-08-24" with-today clearable />

Persian output

config('mds.persian_digits') — on by default in a real app, off in these docs — switches the digits, the month names, the placeholder, the range separator («تا» instead of an en dash) and every label to Persian; :fa="true" does it for one field. The calendar system does not move with it.

روز تحویل
قالب تاریخ: سال/ماه/روز انتخاب‌شده: ۱۴۰۵/۰۵/۲۹
در ساعات اداری بازه‌ی اقامت
قالب تاریخ: سال/ماه/روز — دو تاریخ با «تا» انتخاب‌شده: ۱۴۰۵/۰۵/۲۹ تا ۱۴۰۵/۰۶/۰۴ 
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4">
    <mds:date-picker :fa="true" label="روز تحویل" description="در ساعات اداری" value="2026-08-20"
        with-today clearable />
    <mds:date-picker :fa="true" mode="range" label="بازه‌ی اقامت" :months="2"
        :value="['2026-08-20', '2026-08-26']" />
</div>
The visible field is Persian; the hidden input still holds 2026-08-20. Machine values never change language.

Reference

mds:date-picker

PropDescription
valueThe selection. A date object, a timestamp, an ISO string, or a date written the way the field writes them; [start, end] or ['start' => …, 'end' => …] in range mode. Unreadable input renders an empty field.
modesingle (default) or range.
minEarliest selectable date.
maxLatest selectable date.
unavailableArray of individual dates to disable inside the bounds.
monthsHow many months the panel shows side by side. Default: 1.
calendarjalali (default) or gregorian — for the grid and for the field.
start-dayFirst column of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).
week-numbersAdds a week-number column to the grid. Default: false.
fixed-weeksAlways draws six rows, so the panel never changes height. Default: false.
selectable-headerMonth and year selects instead of the grid title. Default: false.
with-todayA "today" shortcut under the grid. Default: false.
formatHow the field writes a date: numeric (default) or long.
nameField name for a plain form post (name[start] / name[end] in range mode), and the key the error bag is read with.
labelField label, and the accessible name of the panel and the grid.
descriptionHelp text under the field.
placeholderDefault: YYYY/MM/DD, or «سال/ماه/روز» with Persian output.
clearableAdds a clear button once there is a value. Default: false.
disabledTakes the whole field out of reach. Default: false.
readonlyStops the typing; the calendar still picks. Default: false.
sizeField height and grid cell size: sm, lg, or the default.
iconLeading icon name, or false for none. Default: calendar.
positionWhere the panel opens: top, bottom (default), start or end.
alignAlignment along that side: start (default), center or end.
invalidApplies error styling.
errorValidation message. Falls back to the bag for name.
faPersian digits and Persian built-in strings. Default: config('mds.persian_digits').
wire:modelBinds to a Livewire property — the hidden input, or x.start / x.end in range mode.
